== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel's glass bead, also referred to as Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel’s marble or Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel's [[glass marble]], is a small, transparent orb approximately the size of a thumbnail. It contains a single blue candle-flame that burns steadily at its center and remains upright regardless of how the object is turned. The bead is warm to the touch and emits a bright, [[sapphire]] light that can shine like a tiny star. Beyond its visual properties, the marble serves as a spiritual anchor; it provides a sense of comfort, order, and rightness to those who hold it, acting as a reminder of hope. It is also noted for its stability, with some suggesting it may be composed of highly stable forged [[madra]] that could last for a millennium. [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]] gave this token to [[Lindon]] as a means of ensuring she could find him easily in the future, promising to return for him when the time comes.}}
